dialogues.speaker: Xona
dialogues.text: Indeed I am, the name's Xona, blacksmith for the Collective of Plenty. My family's worked the forge for generations — plowshares, weapons, pretty much every piece of metal in this tribe has been shaped by me or my ancestors.

dialogues.speaker: Xona
dialogues.text: Our warriors might prefer wrestling with their bare hands, but when it comes to fighting the Abyss, weapons are a must.

dialogues.speaker: Xona
dialogues.text: I was raised at my father's forge, learning to take cold metal and work it into our traditional tribal weapons of war.

dialogues.speaker: Xona
dialogues.text: Strong, practical, nothing flashy, that's what our weapons are known for. Every blade, no matter how sharp, still relies on a warrior's strength.
